bug_semantics: An MCP caller can invoke smart_user with operation=get-user-info, useCache=false, and an attacker-controlled username. SmartUser.run dispatches that request through getUserInfo(options) to getUserDetails(options.username), which on Unix interpolates username into `getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:" /etc/passwd` and passes the resulting string to promisified child_process.exec. POSIX command substitution remains active inside double quotes, so a username containing `$(...)` or backticks executes arbitrary commands with the MCP server process's privileges.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable smart-user.ts implementation did not originate in an independently authored commit visible in this repository. Commit fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff added the entire file while importing the complete pre-existing hypercontext tools package; PR #6 explicitly labels fc35825 as the initial integration of 367 hypercontext tool files. Because an import/move is not a BIC under the audit protocol, the smallest commit that originally wrote the vulnerable shell interpolation lies in the unavailable hypercontext source history.
ai_marker: unavailable: the true BIC commit object is behind the non-public hypercontext source-history boundary. The target-repository import commit's commit-object AI signal is deliberately excluded because fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff is an import, not the commit that originally authored the flawed mechanism.
evidence: The bundled GHSA-49mq-fc6q-3h46 advisory identifies CWE-78 in @ooples/token-optimizer-mcp <5.1.0, first patched in 5.1.0, and links mainline fix b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7.

At target-history first appearance fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff, src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts lines 22-26 import child_process.exec and define execAsync=promisify(exec); lines 1502-1525 expose MCP tool smart_user, operation get-user-info, and caller-supplied username; lines 199-200 dispatch to getUserInfo; lines 374-403 pass options.username to getUserDetails; lines 917-919 execute the injectable getent/grep shell string.

`git log --all -S'getent passwd "${username}"' -- src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts` finds the target-repository addition at fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff and removals at direct branch fix 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326 and mainline squash fix b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7. `git log -L 917,919:src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts 4ae7c351659b3a1a7f741f6dc427577aead9fdd8` likewise reaches fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff as the earliest target commit for those lines.

`git diff-tree --name-status fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff -- src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts` reports A, while `git ls-tree fd39560c09415bd9b81d48f8cf9fe40f38e5b417 -- src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts` is empty. This proves absence from the import commit's immediate parent, but not absence from the unavailable source package's true BIC parent, so introducer_parent_absent remains false.

First-party PR https://github.com/ooples/token-optimizer-mcp/pull/6 describes a complete hypercontext tools package integration and names fc35825 as `Initial Integration` of 367 files. The mainline merge is 5b22476fa4689aac1218e650106e494123c4805b; `git merge-base --is-ancestor fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff 5b22476fa4689aac1218e650106e494123c4805b` succeeds, decomposing the merge to its import member but not through the external-source boundary.

No public source history was recoverable: https://github.com/ooples/hypercontext-mcp returns 404, the author's GitHub repository listing filtered for `hypercontext` reports zero matching public repositories, and an exact public-code search for the distinctive SmartUser header did not locate another repository. The validated target clone has no hypercontext remote/ref.

Direct fix 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326 changes smart-user.ts to execFileSafe argv mode: lookupPasswdEntry validates username, calls getent as ['passwd', username], and scans /etc/passwd in-process as fallback; getUserDetails calls that helper. Advisory-linked b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 squashes the five-commit fix branch onto main.

Version boundary is consistent with the advisory: fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff is an ancestor of prepatch tag v5.0.1; b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 is not an ancestor of v5.0.1; `git tag --contains b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 --sort=version:refname` begins at v5.1.0, and the fix is an ancestor of v5.1.0, whose package.json declares version 5.1.0.
reasoning: The vulnerability lifecycle and repair are closed: a tool caller controls username, the get-user-info dispatch reaches child_process.exec with shell-interpolated input, command substitution yields local code execution, and 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326 removes the shell sink before the advisory-linked mainline fix b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 ships in v5.1.0. Causal attribution is not closed. History search decomposes the mainline integration merge to fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff and directly verifies that file absent from its parent, but the commit and PR both establish that fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff imported a complete pre-existing hypercontext package. Treating that move as the BIC would violate the protocol and could misattribute the original flawed lines based on the importer commit object. Since the source package's commit history is not public or present in the validated clone, the true BIC SHA, its immediate parent/tree, and its commit-object AI signal cannot be inspected; BLOCKED is therefore the only supported verdict.
remaining_gap: The original hypercontext package repository/history is unavailable. Closing the case requires the commit that first authored the getUserDetails username-to-child_process.exec interpolation in that source history, its immediate parent tree to verify absence, and that exact BIC commit object for AI-marker inspection.
